string.command.help.root:
Commands for Catalyst Graves

/grave find [player]: outputs grave locations with direct TP
/grave tp <index>: direct teleportation (requires Corporeal Recall)
/grave restore [player] [index]: returns items from active grave
/grave recover [player]: gives snapshot copy of death inventory
/grave backup list [player]: shows 10 persistent backups
/grave backup restore <slot> [player]: restores a specific backup
string.command.help.find: Search for the player's active graves with clickable direct teleportation (if Corporeal Recall is unlocked).
string.command.help.restore: Restores a player's active grave if they cannot recover it, placing items at their feet.
string.command.help.recover: Gives a copy of the player's latest death snapshot in the form of packed chests.
